newsitem.title: USA: Novametrix holder group prevails in proxy.
newsitem.headline: Novametrix holder group prevails in proxy.

text.p: Novametrix Medical Systems Inc said on Monday that -- according to voting results -- a stockhoder group which oppposed the company's proposed merger with Andros Holdings Inc had prevailed in its proxy contest.
But the company said it still believed the merger with Andros would ultimately be consummated.

The inspectors of shareholder election at the annual meeting certified the shareholder group prevailed in the proxy contest and that Paul Cote and Vartan Ghugasian were elected as Class A directors of the company.

The company said it was studying its options as a result of the shareholder vote but still thought the Andros merger would go ahead. If it did not, Novametrix said it would recognize approximately $800,000 of merger related expenses in a future reporting period.
